title: Book Two · Chapter 25: Lunch Comes First
story:
On Thursday, Miss Wu gives the pair their pages back.

The grey patch is still in the second box. Ronan touches the edge of the card. Jun moves it into the middle of the desk.

“We can use words over here,” Jun says. He points beside the damaged picture.

Ronan opens his copy of the story.

“I missed after. Your notes were wrong because I gave you the wrong order.”

Jun nods. “We need to change both boxes.”

“I am sorry.”

“All right. Now show me the line.”

Ronan puts a finger below the sentence. He reads it once, slowly. Then he takes his hand away and tells Jun the order.

“The girl and her mum eat lunch. Then the girl returns the bowl.”

“Does the story name another bowl?”

“No.”

“Then we do not need one.”

Jun crosses out LUNCH in the third box. He writes it after SOUP in the second. Ronan puts BOWL BACK in the third box. He draws a short line under the word after on his own story copy.

Miss Wu stops beside them.

“Which part changed?”

“The order,” Ronan says. “I missed one word.”

Jun shows her the two boxes. She reads the line herself. Then she gives them one small strip of clean paper.

“Use this over the thin part,” she says.

Ronan wants a whole new card. He looks at Jun. His partner lays the strip over the grey patch. There is enough space for two short notes.

“I can write here,” Jun says.

They paste only the ends of the strip. The card needs a little time to dry. They leave it flat and work from the story copies.

This time Jun begins. He tells the first part. Ronan listens for lunch and the return. Both come in the right order.

Then Ronan tells the last part.

“The woman washes the bowl. She puts three apples in it. The girl brings an apple home.”

“Three apples in the bowl,” Jun says. “One apple for the girl.”

“I said an apple.”

“I know. I want that on the card too.”

Ronan writes ONE beside a tiny apple in the last box. Jun checks it, then puts his pencil away.

“We have time for another turn,” Ronan says.

“I need to finish my number work.”

“It will be quick.”

“Then you can read your copy. I need this time.”

Ronan moves his sheet to his own side. He reads the soup line again. Then he reads it at a more normal speed. He can keep after in the sentence at both speeds.

Jun works on his numbers. He rubs out one answer and writes another. Ronan does not tell him to hurry.

At lunch, the two boys sit near the open window. Jun has a large piece of bread. Ronan has a small bun.

“Want half?” Jun asks.

Ronan puts half his bun beside half Jun's bread. They taste the two kinds.

“Your half is better,” Jun says.

“You can give it back.”

Jun takes another bite. “Too late.”

Ronan laughs. The repaired card stays flat on the classroom shelf until the next lesson.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- missed＝漏掉了
- damaged＝弄坏的
- strip＝窄纸条
- bite＝一口

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样具体承认并修正自己的错误？
2. Jun为什么拒绝马上再练一遍？

## 从认词到读句子

正文原句：*They leave it flat and work from the story copies.*

**They / leave it flat / and work from the story copies.**

他们／让卡片平放／并使用故事页练习。it指刚修补的卡片。
